label: WAH rope access — WAH-H6 CCVS, monitoring required

project_meta.principal_contractor: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd
project_meta.pcbu_name: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd

inference.hrcw_category: WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.2 — Construction work at height — risk of fall >2m
permits: Working at heights permit — signed before elevated work
qualifications: Competent person — rescue plan in place before work starts
regulatory_notes: WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.2 — HRCW notification to SafeWork NSW if required

tasks.scope: Set up anchor points, lines and descenders for facade access
hazards: Fall from height — anchor failure or incorrect rigging
Dropped tools — strike injury to persons below
controls: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — CCVS WAH-H6: anchor point load-tested by competent person before use
Exclusion zone below work area — barricaded, signage posted
Tool lanyards on all hand tools
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — Anchor points load-tested and signed off before descent
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: wind speed exceeds 45km/h
🛑 STOP WORK if: anchor point integrity in question
admin: Rescue plan completed and on site before work starts

responsibility.SUP: Verify anchor points, sign permit, brief workers
responsibility.WKR: Rig per procedure, check harness before descent

monitoring.critical_control: Check anchor point load test record sighted before each descent
monitoring.evidence: Signed load test record and permit on site

tasks.task: Carry out facade repairs at height
tasks.scope: Crack injection, render patch and coating application from rope access
hazards: Fall from height — harness or line failure
Chemical exposure — epoxy and coating products at height
controls: Continuous connection to rope system — never unclip both lines simultaneously
Chemical-resistant gloves worn — no solvent contact
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — Supervisor visual check of harness fit before each descent
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: weather conditions deteriorate
🛑 STOP WORK if: worker shows signs of fatigue or distress
admin: Buddy system — no solo rope access work

responsibility.WKR: Follow rope procedures, report any equipment concern

monitoring.critical_control: Confirm dual anchor connection before worker leaves platform
monitoring.evidence: Visual check recorded in site diary

task_names: Carry out facade repairs at height
